name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd
title: Sanathan Textiles Ltd - 544314 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Consolidated Q4 EBITDA ₹94.4 cr at 8.1% margin as Punjab ramps, but FY27 target of >₹500 cr EBITDA implies a big step-up; Phase 2 capex (end-FY27) and high working-capital build make execution the key test.

utilisation.quote: we have all operated that through the year at about 95%

capex.peers_comment: Gail and Indian Oil PTA capacity delayed on West Asia raw-material issues, not directly comparable to company capex.
capex.quote: we are progressing with the doubling of our technical yarn capacity at Silvassa from 9,000 metric tons per annum to 18,000 metric tons per annum

triggers.label: Silvassa utilisation ~95% through FY26
triggers.quote: we have all operated that through the year at about 95%

triggers.label: FY27 consol EBITDA >₹500 cr vs ₹284 cr FY26
triggers.quote: We are looking at north of INR 500 crores for the FY27 EBITDA margins

triggers.label: Inventory and payables inflated by ₹180 cr in-transit RM
triggers.quote: there was raw material in transit of close to INR 180 crores

triggers.label: Cotton yarn realisation marginally higher
triggers.quote: it's somewhat similar but a marginally higher realization, particularly on the cotton front

guidance.quote: we expect to do about INR 2,600 crores at Punjab
So a consol revenue of about INR 5,600 to INR 5,700 crores
We are looking at north of INR 500 crores for the FY27 EBITDA margins
we aim to definitely do a double-digit EBITDA at on a consol basis
your PBT would be in the range of about INR 225 crores, INR 230 crores or INR 250 crores
about 7,500 to 7,700 will be the peak revenue
we are expecting a payouts of close to INR 100 to INR 125 crores every year
we aim to complete what we had predicted earlier in FY27, end of FY27

guidance.value: 9,000 to 18,000 MTPA, commissioning end Q1 FY27
guidance.quote: commission by the end of the first quarter
